items: UPS sets 5.9% average increase for Dec. 21. Daily Rates for Ground, Air and International rise an average net 5.9%, and the Additional Handling minimum billable weight moves from 40 to 50 lbs. Area Surcharge and zone ZIP lists change, and Qualified customers shipping Ground and Ground Saver face a new origin-ZIP surcharge.

UPS resets fuel surcharge tables from Nov. 2. The new Ground table runs from 28.50% (diesel $5.53–$5.80) to 31.50% ($6.79–$6.88), and the Domestic Air table from 31.50% to 34.50%. Out-of-range anchor prices rose from $4.99 to $5.80 for Ground and from $3.01 to $3.56 for Air.

MAK terminates UniUni reverse take-over agreement. MAK Acquisition Corp. said Oct. 20 it delivered a termination notice under the May 15, 2026 purchase agreement. The deal will not proceed, and MAK is withdrawing its June 10 preliminary prospectus.
